title: Action::Copy match arm does not call copy_document

wrong-copy-handler.message: This Action::Copy match arm does not call copy_document.
wrong-copy-handler.help: Confirm the arm intentionally delegates elsewhere, or call self.copy_document(...) as the other arms do for their own variant.

metadata.source: Synthetic example demonstrating ast.v1's contextual pattern form (context + selector) on a Rust match arm, a node kind that cannot stand alone as a bare pattern.
